title: Fix broken CSS layout and overflow
when: Elements overlap, a page scrolls sideways, text spills out of cards, or flex and grid items do not line up.
prompt:
Goal: A layout that holds at every width from 320 px up, with no sideways scroll and no text escaping its box.
Steps:
1. Find the widest element: temporarily add outline: 1px solid red to * and look for what crosses the viewport.
2. Set box-sizing: border-box globally so padding does not add to widths.
3. Replace fixed widths with max-width: 100% or min() and let flex items shrink with min-width: 0 on the item.
4. Wrap long words and URLs with overflow-wrap: anywhere; images get max-width: 100% and height: auto.
5. Use grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr)) for card rows instead of hard coded column counts.
6. Remove the debug outline and check 320, 375, 768 and 1280 px.
Quality bar:
- No horizontal scroll at any tested width.
- Content order matches the HTML order.
- Fixes are in the stylesheet, not inline styles.
Pitfalls:
- overflow-x: hidden on body to hide the symptom.
- 100vw widths that ignore the scrollbar.
- Negative margins that push content out of the container.
Verify:
- [ ] Long words and URLs wrap inside cards.
- [ ] Flex children do not overflow their parent.
- [ ] Images scale down.
- [ ] CSS braces balance.
Output: The corrected stylesheet with a short note of the rules changed.

examples.input: my page scrolls sideways on mobile
examples.output: a 600px table and long URLs: wrapped the table in an overflow-x: auto box, overflow-wrap on text, min-width: 0 on flex items
